{
  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "Survey of documented benchmark contamination cases (C4, GPT-3, BIG-bench, GSM-8K, ChatGPT/CoNLL2003), then the paper's definition of data contamination and its three types (guideline, raw text, annotation), and contamination at the pre-training and supervised fine-tuning steps."
  },
  "concepts": [
    {
      "id": "c_data_contamination",
      "name": "data contamination",
      "aliases": ["Data contamination"],
      "description": "Any breach in the strict control of datasets required by the experimental protocol; in this paper, the case where an LLM has processed the evaluation benchmark during its pre-training.",
      "anchor": "data contamination refers",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_guideline_contamination",
      "name": "Guideline contamination",
      "aliases": ["guideline contamination"],
      "description": "Contamination in which the annotation guidelines for a specific dataset are seen by the model.",
      "anchor": "Guideline contamination happens",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_raw_text_contamination",
      "name": "Raw text contamination",
      "aliases": ["raw text contamination", "text contamination"],
      "description": "Contamination in which the original text, prior to annotation, is seen by the model.",
      "anchor": "Raw text contamination happens",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_annotation_contamination",
      "name": "Annotation contamination",
      "aliases": ["annotation contamination"],
      "description": "Contamination in which the annotations (labels) of the target benchmark are exposed to the model during training.",
      "anchor": "Annotation contamination happens",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_pretraining",
      "name": "pre-training",
      "aliases": ["pre-training step"],
      "description": "The first step of the standard LLM training procedure, in which undesired data gathered from the internet is hard to filter completely.",
      "anchor": "During the pre-training",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_supervised_finetuning",
      "name": "supervised fine-tuning",
      "aliases": ["instruction-tuning"],
      "description": "The training step following pre-training, where contamination can also occur but is less frequent because training data is documented.",
      "anchor": "supervised fine-tuning or",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_c4_corpus",
      "name": "C4 corpus",
      "aliases": ["C4"],
      "description": "A corpus used to pre-train several LLMs such as T5, found to contain test splits of several benchmarks crawled from GitHub.",
      "anchor": "the C4 corpus",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    }
  ],
  "definitions": [
    {
      "id": "d_data_contamination",
      "term": "data contamination",
      "verbatim_text": "In general, data contamination refers to any breach\nin the strict control of datasets required by the ex-\nperimental protocol.",
      "normative_status": "academic",
      "anchor": "data contamination refers",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_guideline_contamination",
      "term": "Guideline contamination",
      "verbatim_text": "Guideline contamination happens when the an-\nnotation guidelines for a specific dataset are seen\nby the model.",
      "normative_status": "academic",
      "anchor": "Guideline contamination happens",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_raw_text_contamination",
      "term": "Raw text contamination",
      "verbatim_text": "Raw text contamination happens when the orig-\ninal text (previous to annotation) is seen by the\nmodel.",
      "normative_status": "academic",
      "anchor": "Raw text contamination happens",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_annotation_contamination",
      "term": "Annotation contamination",
      "verbatim_text": "Annotation contamination happens when the\nannotations (labels) of the target benchmark are\nexposed to the model during training.",
      "normative_status": "academic",
      "anchor": "Annotation contamination happens",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "cl_c4_test_splits",
      "claim_text": "exposed that the C4 corpus (Raf-\nfel et al., 2020), a corpus used to pre-train sev-\neral LLMs such as T5 (Raffel et al., 2020), con-\ntained the test splits of several benchmarks that\nwere crawled from GitHub.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "peer_reviewed_experiment",
      "anchor": "were crawled from GitHub",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_gpt3_bug",
      "claim_text": "acknowledged a bug in their filter-\ning script that caused the contamination of several\nbenchmarks during the GPT-3 training.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "(2020) acknowledged a bug",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_bigbench_mixed",
      "claim_text": "parts of the BIG-\nbench (Srivastava et al., 2023) benchmark were\ninadvertently mixed into the training set, enough\nto stop them from evaluating the model on it.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "inadvertently mixed into the training set",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_gsm8k_not_zeroshot",
      "claim_text": "the performance results reported for GSM-8K\ncannot be taken as zero-shot results when compared\nto other models.",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "inference",
      "anchor": "cannot be taken as zero-shot results",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_chatgpt_compromised",
      "claim_text": "several benchmarks have already been com-\npromised in ChatGPT, including the popular\nCoNLL2003 (Tjong Kim Sang and De Meulder,\n2003).",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "Sainz et al. (2023) reported",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_guideline_advantage",
      "claim_text": "A model aware of the guidelines for a spe-\ncific task or dataset has advantages over a model\nwithout such information.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "inference",
      "anchor": "has advantages over a model",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_wikipedia_markup",
      "claim_text": "Models\nthat have already seen Wikipedia in its original\nform (including the markup annotations) have more\ninformation to better identify a part of the annota-\ntions (the entity boundaries) of the dataset.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "inference",
      "anchor": "including the markup annotations",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_eval_split_invalidates",
      "claim_text": "When\nthe evaluation split is involved, the experiment is\ncompletely invalidated.",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "inference",
      "anchor": "completely invalidated",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_avoidance_unrealistic",
      "claim_text": "Avoiding data contam-\nination completely is not realistic, as it is impos-\nsible to know every dataset that the research com-\nmunity can test an LLM on.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "inference",
      "anchor": "completely is not realistic",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_sft_less_frequent",
      "claim_text": "it is much less frequent as it\nis a required practice in the research community\nto document the training data in order to publish\nyour findings.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "inference",
      "anchor": "much less frequent",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_benchmarks_in_c4",
      "claim_text": "various standard benchmarks were found in the\nC4 (Raffel et al., 2020) corpus.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "peer_reviewed_experiment",
      "anchor": "various standard benchmarks were found",
      "location": "sainz-2023-llm-data-contamination#c0002"
    }
  ],
